title: The SessionEnd launcher proof records the session's exit code and whether breakaway or the fallback ran
goal: kb/_self/reports/windows-run.md's SessionEnd launcher section records the interactive session's exit code and whether the launcher's child broke away from the job (CREATE_BREAKAWAY_FROM_JOB) or took the fallback, and states that LAUNCH_BUDGET_S bounds the launcher's return and the .end marker, not the run file; found by the SP-kjqdiudr review (ST-bgfsi3n2, whose goal asked for a run file within LAUNCH_BUDGET_S).
